steps.content: After secretly leaving Inner Bay, you return to Syndicate, where the streets are just as you had remembered them.
A black raven flies out from the poetry book and pecks at the gangster's eyes, repelling him. A few Rustfire combatants also rush over to cover you, giving you time to react.
You effortlessly cast your shackles, repelling the manic enemies and saving several terrified refugees in the alley.
At the same time, the area touched by the shackles shows you another scene.
The horrific burns spread through the streets and scale the walls, merging with the gangsters' fire to light up Syndicate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...No wonder we had such a hard time fighting in Inner Bay.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This wasn't caused by fighting between Rustfire and the Executive Committee. The monster must have taken advantage of the chaos and accumulated a lot more power.
The bad thing is, the upcoming battle will be very troublesome. But the good thing is, you have some more bargaining chips.

Mixed with the roar of bullets and explosions, the human shrieks sound especially distorted. Many have already undergone visible mutations, and are hunting for any possible conscious target to attack. It's only a matter of time before they find you.
Before going into combat mode, you pick up a secret phone call.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Long time no see, Chief. Can you tell me what happened during your absence?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I can't do that at the moment, sorry.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I have something urgent to ask you. I need the FAC's help, and maybe even the 9th Agency's.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Go ahead, I'm all ears. Judging from the vibrant noises around you, we're probably going to lose contact with each other again soon.
